lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Nani, stop the scooter before the police see that illegal nitro tank [beat] sticking out of your shopping basket!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Nix, those aren't just groceries; they are high-octane stabilizers [beat] meant to win the Neighborhood Grand Prix tonight!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: I thought you were just a gamer, Nix, but you are actually riding [beat] with the legendary Stunt Queen of the suburbs!

lines.speaker: mr_haque
lines.text: Nobody beats my custom lawnmower engine, especially not an old lady [beat] carrying a bag of fresh ginger and organic milk!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Watch me drift through this intersection [beat] while I check my grocery list to make sure I did not forget the dozen eggs!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The speedometer just hit eighty miles per hour [beat] and we are currently overtaking a literal sports car on the sidewalk!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: I knew Nani was fast at the buffet, but seeing her pull a wheelie [beat] on a vintage Vespa is something I will never unsee!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: The secret is in the wrist, Nix; never let them know [beat] that you are actually terrified of hitting a stray cat or a trash can!

lines.speaker: mr_haque
lines.text: How did a seventy-year-old woman [beat] just leave my turbo-charged mower in a cloud of jasmine-scented exhaust smoke?

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nani! I asked you to get milk thirty minutes ago [beat] and you have somehow managed to win a gold trophy and a street reputation!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: The milk is still cold, Lubna, and Nix here is now my official [beat] head mechanic and secondary stunt coordinator for next week!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I went out for a quick snack and came back as the official heir [beat] to the most dangerous scooter racing empire in the city!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so, the Stunt Queen retired her helmet [beat] until the next time the local grocery store announced a fifty percent flash sale.
